data.comment:
# Comfy Grok- Video Edit

Upload a video to edit. Input your desired modifications. Generate an edited video using the Grok API. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_grok_video_edit.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: 1990s Japanese manga style, retro anime aesthetic, cel-shaded, hand-drawn animation. First-person POV of a futuristic motorcycle speeding through a rainy cyberpunk city with intense motion blur and speed lines. Robotic arms on handlebars, glowing yellow neon accents. Low angle close-up of the spinning rear tire on wet asphalt. Vintage film grain, dynamic action, atmospheric lighting.
